description: This file defines interfaces and constants for an event loop handling I/O events and alarms in the QUIC protocol implementation, including socket event listeners, event loop abstraction, and factory.

classes.name: QuicSocketEventListener
classes.description: Interface for objects that listen to socket events on a file descriptor.

classes.name: QuicEventLoop
classes.description: Abstract class representing an event loop capable of handling alarms and I/O events.

classes.name: QuicEventLoopFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of QuicEventLoop.

methods.name: SupportsEdgeTriggered
methods.description: Indicates if the event loop supports edge-triggered notifications.

methods.name: RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with the event loop to listen for specified events.

methods.name: UnregisterSocket
methods.description: Removes a socket from the event loop.

methods.name: RearmSocket
methods.description: Re-arms a socket to listen for additional events (requires non-edge-triggered support).

methods.name: ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Manually triggers an event notification for a socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs a single iteration of the event loop.

methods.name: CreateAlarmFactory
methods.description: Creates an alarm factory for scheduling alarms.

methods.name: GetClock
methods.description: Returns the clock used by the event loop.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new event loop instance.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name of the event loop implementation.
